steps.title: Bring orbs with you to the …
steps.text: Bring orbs with you to the Wizards’ Guild in Yanille, buy, make, and alch the staves in the shop while hopping and buying nature runes (50 per world until you have 500). Boost with a Wizard’s mind bomb to get in.

steps.text: make and alch them in the bank. Repeat the whole process a second time. This brings the cash stack up to ~162k (bring ~24 orbs, buy+alch everything slowly, then buy out another 26 staves and attach+alch in bank, repeat). After this buy staves with your entire cash stack, banking them.

steps.title: Run artefacts in Piscarillius while attaching …
steps.text: Run artefacts in Piscarillius while attaching the staves to the orbs and alching them while running, using your Kharedst’s memoirs for transportation and dueling rings to Ferox Enclave to bank and/or restore run energy as needed. Repeat this process of buying staves in Yanille, attaching and alching orbs while running artefacts until all 1590 have been processed. Also buy 500 law runes and 500 soul runes (50 per world) in Yanille in between buying battlestaves.

steps.title: Train construction to level 50 using …
steps.text: Train construction to level 50 using oak logs at the Rimmington portal. Method: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GFH6-oJrJ0o should be ~1200 oak planks for 38-50 Construction, 60 xp per plank. Don’t wait for the servant to come back, this method will bank the planks (if your POH instance is closed while your servant returns the planks will go straight to your bank) and you can use them from the bank later (have the servant grab the planks from the bank for you while you stay in the POH), for example with oak larders.

steps.text: Do Shilo Village (if you have rogue kits they can help save inventory space during this quest). It’s worth considering getting a few extra in case all your gems for One Small Favour break. Buy four inventories of cooked karambwans from Alfonse the waiter in The Shrimp and Parrot (Brimhaven restaurant), banking in Shilo using the Hajedy & Vigroy cart system (right click to travel, going through dialogue is cheaper but not worth the time).

steps.text: pick attack and defence (35k). Fletch an oak shortbow in the Gnome Stronghold (rebank if needed) for the diary - bank it if you want to woo/befriend the princess during Throne of Miscellania later. Score a goal in Gnome Ball

steps.title: complete a lap of the Gnome …
steps.text: complete a lap of the Gnome Agility Course

steps.title: kill terrorbirds for Rag and Bone …
steps.text: kill terrorbirds for Rag and Bone Man II.

steps.title: Take a delivery order for the …
steps.text: Take a delivery order for the gnome restaurant.

steps.title: Take the agility shortcut to Otto’s …
steps.text: Take the agility shortcut to Otto’s Grotto for the diary.

steps.title: Complete the delivery order for the …
steps.text: Complete the delivery order for the diary.

steps.title: Minigame teleport to Shades of Mort’ton, …
steps.text: Minigame teleport to Shades of Mort’ton, buy a limestone (if you already have this from wintertodt skip it), a plank and 8 limestone bricks from Razmire (or do this after the quest), do Haunted Mine.

steps.title: Collect (one inventory of) spare salve …
steps.text: Collect (one inventory of) spare salve crystals.

steps.title: Get to Brimhaven and continue Heroes’ …
steps.text: Get to Brimhaven and continue Heroes’ Quest (“osrs soa” clan chat can help). Chronicle teleport to Varrock

steps.title: get the Thieves’ armband. Games necklace …
steps.text: get the Thieves’ armband. Games necklace teleport to Burthorpe

steps.title: complete Heroes’ Quest.
steps.text: complete Heroes’ Quest.

steps.title: Kill the blue dragon for the …
steps.text: Kill the blue dragon for the diary.

steps.title: Buy 300 law runes, 1100 nature …
steps.text: Buy 300 law runes, 1100 nature runes, top up your death rune stack to 3k (Watchtower teleport and buy in Yanille). If you do not have a Rune Pouch yet

steps.title: use the minigames teleport to Clan …
steps.text: use the minigames teleport to Clan Wars and do Last Man Standing to obtain both a rune pouch and a magic shortbow scroll. Do Big Chompy Bird Hunting, save a raw chompy for later. Do Zogre Flesh Eaters (use dueling rings for speeding up the quest), killing Zogres along the way for Rag and Bone Man II.

steps.title: Make sure to unlock Uglug’s Stuffsies
steps.text: Make sure to unlock Uglug’s Stuffsies

steps.title: buy 16 relicym’s balm (3), decant …
steps.text: buy 16 relicym’s balm (3), decant them into 12 4-dose potions.

steps.title: Use Crumble Undead for the Slash …
steps.text: Use Crumble Undead for the Slash Bash fight.

steps.title: Buy and smelt 1100 gold ore …
steps.text: Buy and smelt 1100 gold ore (or exactly as many as it takes to get to level 50), 6 iron bars and 20 steel bars and 27 mithril bars, buying the ore if needed. Save a few hundred gold bars for jewellery, the rest are to be alched. This uses a significant amount of energy pots, if you have/had any.

steps.title: Make sure to equip your ring …
steps.text: Make sure to equip your ring of charos (a) to reduce the foreman cost.

steps.title: Keep wearing your ring of charos …
steps.text: Keep wearing your ring of charos (a). Teleport to Falador.

steps.title: Run south to Port Sarim.
steps.text: Run south to Port Sarim.

steps.title: Start and complete the Pandemonium quest. …
steps.text: Start and complete the Pandemonium quest. Whenever sailing you get some XP and a speed boost for trimming sails, so try to consistently click the sail when there’s a burst of wind. You need the sail trimming xp to hit level 22 later. Do port courier tasks (between Pandemonium and Port Sarim) until level 14 sailing, aiming to finish the level at Port Sarim. Best is to pick up all tasks between these two destinations, regardless of start and end points, stringing them together as much as possible. You can multiskill alch or fletch while sailing as desired.

steps.title: Complete the following charting tasks along …
steps.text: Complete the following charting tasks along the way:

steps.title: If you were at Port Sarim, …
steps.text: If you were at Port Sarim, charter to the Pandemonium. Start Prying Times (bank to grab the items necessary on Pandemonium). Charter or sail back (if you’re sailing, complete another port task as well).

steps.title: Pick up the crate of looty
steps.text: Pick up the crate of looty

steps.title: return to the Pandemonium, grabbing and …
steps.text: return to the Pandemonium, grabbing and completing a second courier task as well along the way. Charter to Port Sarim

steps.title: run to Thurgo
steps.text: run to Thurgo

steps.title: get the crowbar
steps.text: get the crowbar

steps.title: return to the Pandemonium.
steps.text: return to the Pandemonium.

steps.title: Board your raft
steps.text: Board your raft

steps.title: head to the sealed crate, also …
steps.text: head to the sealed crate, also chart the wreck of the Pandemonium II and the crashed gnome glider to the west.

steps.title: Open the crate, sail to the …
steps.text: Open the crate, sail to the Pandemonium docks

steps.title: drink the drink. You can either …
steps.text: drink the drink. You can either kill the troll or just disembark your ship

steps.title: complete Prying Times.
steps.text: complete Prying Times.

steps.title: Search a nearby crate for the …
steps.text: Search a nearby crate for the waterlogged journal

steps.title: read it to unlock the ability …
steps.text: read it to unlock the ability to make the Medallion of the Deep.

steps.title: Chart around the area using the …
steps.text: Chart around the area using the route described in this image, getting you to level 22 sailing as you arrive at Catherby 20260215OSRS14-22ChartingRoute.png. Do not forget the spyglass for Keep le Faye just north of the image. The start point is deep in the Lumbridge Basin, so make your way there first. Whenever charting, collect drinks in your inventory and only start drinking them after you have docked your boat at your destination, https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Sealed_crate tells you which drinks have negative effects.

steps.title: Start and complete Current Affairs in …
steps.text: Start and complete Current Affairs in full. Note: for the current duck charting you do not have to follow the duck, you only need to set it loose

steps.title: pick it up at the endpoint …
steps.text: pick it up at the endpoint before it despawns, which is quite a generous timer. You can therefore combine this activity with other sailing in the area.

steps.title: Buy a skiff
steps.text: Buy a skiff

steps.title: build an iron helm and an …
steps.text: build an iron helm and an oak mast and linen sails on it.

steps.title: Buy 25 repair kits and put …
steps.text: Buy 25 repair kits and put them in your cargo hold, using them whenever appropriate (keep in mind you can also repair your ship every time you are at a shipwright, which is recommended). Chart most of the Ardent Ocean using the route in red in 20260215OSRS24-30ChartingRoute.png. The starting point is near Catherby. After reaching the Ruins of Unkah

steps.title: drink the Bottle of slug’s mind …
steps.text: drink the Bottle of slug’s mind balm last (it teleports you to Witchhaven)

steps.title: run to Ardougne docks, charter a …
steps.text: run to Ardougne docks, charter a ship to Musa Point and recover your skiff. Then sail the orange route, visiting current duck spots. Dock at the Pandemonium.

steps.title: If you are already level 31 …
steps.text: If you are already level 31 sailing, upgrade your skiff with a teak hull. If not, sail south, complete the swordfish rank of the Tempor Tantrum to get the level

steps.title: return and upgrade the hull. Continue …
steps.text: return and upgrade the hull. Continue doing laps of Tempor Tantrum (unlock all difficulties, then do Marlin rank for xp) until at least 35,000 xp (level 39).

steps.title: Make sure to collect the stormy …
steps.text: Make sure to collect the stormy key, barrel stand and the Whirlpool surprises.

steps.title: Using the route in 20260215OSRS39-45ChartingRoute.png(starting at …
steps.text: Using the route in 20260215OSRS39-45ChartingRoute.png(starting at the Tempor Tantrum), chart a good portion of the Unquiet Ocean. Once you reach the end of this trek, make sure your ship is stationary before drinking the bottle of alone at sea (a 75 second cutscene will play while your ship keeps moving if it’s not stationary!)

steps.title: teleport out, minigame teleport to Port …
steps.text: teleport out, minigame teleport to Port Khazard, recover your skiff

steps.title: build an inoculation station
steps.text: build an inoculation station

steps.title: complete the mermaid diving charts in …
steps.text: complete the mermaid diving charts in the Strait of Khazard and Gu’tanoth Bay. This completes the charting for the Ardent Ocean.

steps.title: Teleport to your POH and charter …
steps.text: Teleport to your POH and charter a ship to the Pandemonium

steps.title: collect the Ardent Ocean xp reward …
steps.text: collect the Ardent Ocean xp reward and the kraken ink stout (buy 25 of them) from Chartin’ Charles McAtless.

steps.title: Buy 48 whirlpool surprises from the …
steps.text: Buy 48 whirlpool surprises from the Pandemonium pub.

steps.title: Build a keg on your skiff
steps.text: Build a keg on your skiff

steps.title: fill it with whirlpool surprise.
steps.text: fill it with whirlpool surprise.

steps.title: Teleport to Falador
steps.text: Teleport to Falador

steps.title: smelt your lead ore into 11 …
steps.text: smelt your lead ore into 11 bars.

steps.title: Pay the estate agent to move …
steps.text: Pay the estate agent to move your house to Rellekka. House teleport.

steps.title: Grab the Fremennik Easy diary, putting …
steps.text: Grab the Fremennik Easy diary, putting the lamp on Herblore.

steps.title: Collect a few pet rocks. Put …
steps.text: Collect a few pet rocks. Put at least one in your POH menagerie

steps.title: collect it again for the diary.
steps.text: collect it again for the diary.

steps.title: Buy a berserker helmet. Your attack …
steps.text: Buy a berserker helmet. Your attack should be at least level 50 by now, if it is not do a bit of slayer (see below in this same step) first.

steps.title: Train slayer to get to level …
steps.text: Train slayer to get to level 50 defence, using your ancient staff as a melee weapon.

steps.title: Teleport to Barbarian Assault, do at …
steps.text: Teleport to Barbarian Assault, do at least one full queen run in any role

steps.title: buy a granite platebody. Recommended: continue …
steps.text: buy a granite platebody. Recommended: continue Barbarian Assault to obtain a Fighter Torso.

steps.title: Continue Scorpion Catcher (catch the scorpion …
steps.text: Continue Scorpion Catcher (catch the scorpion inside the Barbarian Outpost agility course), do a lap of the agility course for the diary. Do Horror from the Deep, kill the Dagannoth Mother w/ magic, like on the wiki.

steps.title: Collect a berserker ring from Dagannoth …
steps.text: Collect a berserker ring from Dagannoth Rex (optional: stay for a dragon axe). Bring your remaining gold bars and nature runes to alch between kills (and between hits). Leave the long way to the Lighthouse for the diary

steps.title: kill dagannoths on your way out …
steps.text: kill dagannoths on your way out for Rag and Bone Man II.

steps.title: Optional and recommended: go to the …
steps.text: Optional and recommended: go to the PVP Arena and imbue your berserker ring. The PVP Arena method involves either an alt/friend to boost points (go at off-peak hours, hope to get matched with each other, quickly die to the other/kill the other for points, repeat) or just suiciding to randoms for quick points Imbue Any Item in Just 10 Minutes with This Amazing Method. Next, alch your granite body. Train slayer to level 40 with shit tier tasks with your ancient staff (you might barely cross 70 combat near the end of this training, so get a Chaeldar task for the diary step if so), training melee on accurate to 60 attack.

steps.title: Buy a dragon scimitar and dragon …
steps.text: Buy a dragon scimitar and dragon dagger if you hit level 60 attack. You can use smoke burst (on accurate/magic) on jellies and ankou tasks.

steps.title: Make sure to complete your final …
steps.text: Make sure to complete your final task at the end. NOTE: it is difficult for us to keep track of all small amounts of combat xp obtained so far, so all combat levels and experience trackers in BRUHsailer are estimates. Do not worry if you are several levels off in either direction.

steps.title: Get on normal spellbook
steps.text: Get on normal spellbook

steps.text: go to Falador

steps.title: start The Slug Menace.
steps.text: start The Slug Menace.

steps.title: Pay the estate agent to move …
steps.text: Pay the estate agent to move your POH to Kourend.

steps.title: Teleport to Ardougne with the cloak
steps.text: Teleport to Ardougne with the cloak

steps.title: start Eagles’ Peak in the Ardougne …
steps.text: start Eagles’ Peak in the Ardougne Zoo. Continue The Slug Menace in Witchhaven. Necklace of passage to Jorral

steps.title: start Making History.
steps.text: start Making History.

steps.title: Run to Eagles’ Peak
steps.text: Run to Eagles’ Peak

steps.title: collect two dashing kebbit fur for …
steps.text: collect two dashing kebbit fur for Varrock Hard diary (if you have the hunter level, it’s fine if you do not)

steps.title: catch a copper longtail for the …
steps.text: catch a copper longtail for the diary

steps.title: mine some iron ore, and continue …
steps.text: mine some iron ore, and continue Eagles’ Peak until you have to make the disguise

steps.title: make sure to collect the feathers.
steps.text: make sure to collect the feathers.

steps.title: Teleport to Ardougne, resume The Slug …
steps.text: Teleport to Ardougne, resume The Slug Menace until you have chiselled the five special runestones.

steps.title: Do Throne of Miscellania and Royal …
steps.text: Do Throne of Miscellania and Royal Trouble (fairy ring CIP to get there), obtain 100% support (buying flowers from the flower girl or chopping Etceteria teak logs), kill Rabbits for Rag and Bone Man II

steps.title: deposit 600k gp (or: your entire …
steps.text: deposit 600k gp (or: your entire cash stack) in Misc

steps.title: set it to 10 mahogany 5 …
steps.text: set it to 10 mahogany 5 maple. The mahogany logs are for bird runs (levels 49-80), the maples for arrow shafts for fletching. Also visit at least once/twice a week to restore the support to 100% (buying flowers from the flower girl or raking the herb patch).

steps.title: Shades of Mort’ton minigame teleport, go …
steps.text: Shades of Mort’ton minigame teleport, go to the Haunted Mine.

steps.title: Mine a mithril ore for the …
steps.text: Mine a mithril ore for the diary (take the mine key for fast access). Visit the Lair of Tarn Razorlor

steps.title: start and complete the miniquest (and …
steps.text: start and complete the miniquest (and kill a terror dog in the process).
